title: Compare campaign receipt presentation in the production lab
description: A developer reviews deterministic campaign feedback produced by the shipped validation, receipt-copy and animation code. These component scenarios exercise presentation parity, not live campaign commands, authorization or migration workers. Each paused animation is declared explicitly; all images retain exact comparison.

verifications: Reduced motion retains identical outcome text and the selected scenario remains explicit.
